Keep a plain white background and the entire character in frame. Do not add or remove garments, accessories, or body parts, and do not increase exposure beyond the outfit in Picture 1. One is a tan tail with black horizontal stripes. The other is a large, fluffy light-blue tail. His arms, legs and feet are bare, exactly as in Picture 1. Keep the illustration style of Picture 1.
